## About
WeCare Tree Care is a tree service on Exchange Ave in Schertz. We trim and shape trees, take down the ones that need to go, remove moss, and clear out lots and yards so the place looks clean when we leave.
Our neighbors have given us a 5 star rating across 89 Google reviews. One reviewer said Harold, Matt, and Augie did a really fine job on the trees in front of their house, and others talk about clear communication and a crew that cleans up after itself.
Tell us what you want done and we'll work out the best plan for your property.

## Services
- Pruning & Demossing: Expert trimming of trees and shrubs to promote healthy growth, enhance aesthetics, and keep things safe. Demossing removes unwanted moss from trees to improve their health and appearance.
- Tree Trimming & Removal: Shaping trees, or removing them when necessary, to keep your property safe and looking good.
- Landscaping & Lot Cleaning: Designing landscapes and clearing debris for a clean, polished look.

## FAQ
Q: Will you clean up after the job?
A: Yes. Reviewers mention the crew cleaning everything up afterward and leaving the property looking good.

Q: What is demossing?
A: Demossing removes unwanted moss from trees. It improves their health and appearance and reduces the risk of damage.

Q: Will you work with me on what I want done?
A: Yes. One reviewer said we took the time to figure out the best solution for their property instead of rushing the job.
